familyIntro:
I am a husband and a father.

That is the ground from which everything else in my life finds expression.

My wife, Dr. Perfect Koka, and my son, Selikem, are central to how I understand responsibility, presence, and the long-term work of building something that actually holds.

Family strips away abstraction. It brings everything back to what is real. Not ideas, but lived commitments.

In that sense, this part of my life is not separate from my work. It is what grounds it.

The rest of my life flows from this. Explore how it takes shape across the different spheres I work in by clicking the buttons below.
